items.title: そうだ アニメ，見よう：第270回は狂気のマネーゲームアニメ「FX戦士くるみちゃん」。萌えアニメの皮をかぶったホラー作品!?
items.summary: 「そうだアニメ，見よう」第270回は，原作・でむにゃん氏，作画・炭酸だいすき氏のマネーゲーム漫画をアニメ化した「FX戦士くるみちゃん」。制作はパッショーネ，シリーズ構成を猪原健太氏が担当。監督を「異修羅」や「見える子ちゃん」の小川優樹氏が務めている。

zh.title: 没错，我们来看动画吧：第270集是疯狂的金钱游戏动画《FX战士胡桃酱》。伪装成萌系动画的恐怖作品！？
zh.summary: 《看动画吧》第270集是《FX战士胡桃酱》，是由Demunyan创作、大寿苏达负责插画的金钱游戏漫画的动画版。制作人：Passione，系列作曲：井野原健太。导演是《Isura》和《Meriko-chan》的导演小川佑树。

en.title: That's right, let's watch the anime: The 270th episode is the crazy money game anime "FX Senshi Kurumi-chan". A horror work disguised as a Moe anime!?
en.summary: The 270th episode of "Let's watch anime" is "FX Senshi Kurumi-chan," which is an animated version of the money game manga written by Demunyan and illustrated by Daisuki Soda. Produced by Passione, series composition by Kenta Inohara. The director is Yuki Ogawa, director of ``Isura'' and ``Meriko-chan.''

items.title: 鹿児島県伊佐市が，ゲームも持たずに東京ゲームショウにやってきた5年間。田舎町にどんな変化が起きたのか，答え合わせのお時間
items.summary: 東京ゲームショウ2026で，鹿児島県伊佐市のブースを取材した。同自治体には2023年のこと，ちょっとした興味から取材していたのだが，今回は「TGS出展の5か年計画の“答え合わせ”はいかがでしょう？」と連絡をもらい，話を聞いてきた。

zh.title: 鹿儿岛县伊佐市在没有拥有游戏的情况下来到东京电玩展已经过去五年了。是时候看看乡村小镇发生了哪些变化。
zh.summary: 在2026年东京电玩展上，我们覆盖了鹿儿岛县伊佐市的展位。出于某种兴趣，我一直在 2023 年左右采访当地政府，但这一次有人联系我并问我：“您有兴趣在 TGS 上参展的五年计划的答案吗？”

en.title: It's been five years since Isa City, Kagoshima Prefecture, came to the Tokyo Game Show without even owning a game. Time to check what changes have occurred in the rural town.
en.summary: At Tokyo Game Show 2026, we covered the booth in Isa City, Kagoshima Prefecture. I had been interviewing the local government about 2023 out of some interest, but this time I was contacted and asked, ``Would you be interested in meeting the answers to the five-year plan for exhibiting at TGS?''

Player Yinuo (Xu Bicheng) became the first and only double gold medal winner in the league in history. On October 8, the "Operation Delta" project team under Tencent's Tianmei Studio Group officially announced that on the second anniversary of its launch, the number of daily active users of the game's national server has exceeded 58 million. In September last year, the game's first anniversary was officially announced to have exceeded 30 million DAU. In March this year, it was officially announced to have exceeded 50 million. This is another historical peak in the past few months, marking that "Operation Delta" has become one of Tencent's evergreens.

en.summary: On September 3, Chule participated in the closed offline trial session of "Shadow Blade Zero" at the invitation of Lingyoufang. The important thing about this demo is that the version available at the event is arguably not that different from the version that will be released soon. During the approximately 5 hours of trial play, we had a relatively complete experience of the story opening, plot CG, level design and boss battles, and even details such as controller feedback. The process covered the entire first chapter of the big map, hidden maps, hidden bosses, a small amount of the second chapter content and two later bosses. If the previous demos released sporadically by Lingyoufang still gave people a feeling of peeking into the background, this time the demos make people feel quite reassured about the overall quality of the game. In terms of exploration and combat experience, "Shadow Blade Zero" maintains a consistently high level; in particular, games in the past have shown less in terms of levels and development, and this time it also brought us the biggest surprise. The newly encountered bosses each have their own characteristics.
